frames.name: 海岸弯道
frames.description: 沿用你偏好的海岸公路，进一步缩小汽车，用崖壁、弯道和海平面拉开空间。
frames.subject: small silver car
frames.brief: Wide coastal road after rain, a small car in the right lower third, 28mm environmental shot, sweeping road into the distance, broad sea horizon, left 38% quiet for copy. Keep the car at 7% of frame width.

frames.name: 高山公路
frames.description: 让两侧山体形成前景框架，公路带视线进入远处。空间纵深强，适合品牌宣传片。
frames.subject: small touring car
frames.brief: Wide alpine pass, layered mountains and a winding road, tiny car in the right lower third, 24mm environment-led view, foreground mountain frame, deep readable valley, left copy-safe region. Car width 6% of frame.

frames.name: 荒原直线
frames.description: 低地平线、大面积天空和偏置消失点。主体更小、构图更安静，开阔感最直接。
frames.subject: distant off-road vehicle
frames.brief: Expansive arid plateau with low horizon and huge open sky, a single offset road receding to a distant small vehicle, 35mm panoramic environmental frame, quiet left 44% for copy. Vehicle width 4.8% of frame.

frames.name: 建筑广场
frames.description: 用建筑体量与一个很小的人物建立尺度。空间整洁、线条克制，适合设计与生活方式内容。
frames.subject: small person in architectural plaza
frames.brief: Wide architectural plaza with a large restrained modern pavilion in the right third and one small person for scale, 28mm perspective, extensive clear ground plane, left 40% quiet copy space. Person height about 9% of frame.

frames.name: 海面帆影
frames.description: 长海平线与小帆船构成极简远景。几乎没有前景遮挡，适合安静、舒展的品牌画面。
frames.subject: small sailboat on an open sea
frames.brief: Expansive quiet sea with a long uninterrupted horizon and one small sailboat to the right, low distant headland at far left, 35mm panoramic shot, large empty water and sky, left 44% copy-safe. Boat width 5.8% of frame.

frames.name: 湖畔远景
frames.description: 远山、湖面和岸线分成三层，人物只作尺度参照。环境叙事更强，适合户外与人物故事。
frames.subject: small lone walker by a lake
frames.brief: Wide highland lake surrounded by layered distant mountains, a quiet curving shore leading to one small lone walker at right, 24mm environmental composition, open lake on left for copy, person height 8% of frame. Environment should dominate.
